body: RULED: ord-co28-sci-vacuum-main-line-estimates-first-1019. Your reading is adopted whole. MAIN LINE: an estimated hull that floats and does not crush at 500 m, from cheap comparisons, with every input tagged QUESTIONABLE and its source. An NFI ledger goes beside it. Each point states its float margin and crush safety factor; below 1, it names the material property and the improvement factor needed. FIRST CARD funded 3600 s, at least three construction families. The owner files by 10-20 06:00 and Una checks by 12:00, only arithmetic and sources. An admitted card is a map point. Owners are grok or claude: codex and glm read 94% of 7 days. RESHAPED: both fit-first orders and the contract card are superseded. The reference route is PARKED, unfunded, after five preparations without a usable fit. It re-enters only when an admitted card names the estimate it would ground. The native card is parallel, now due 10-21 12:00. The 18:08 incomplete return is closed, with 1054.72 s charged on the conservative basis. The 10-22 report and the five-day card re-base on the main line. Unchanged: no pause, and the private-paper, public-title and pool rules.
